datasets.name: ClientAccs
datasets.sql:
SELECT   ac.id AS id, ac.kli_id AS custid, ac.acc_no AS accno,
         ac.NAME AS clientname, ac.val_acc
    FROM account ac
   WHERE
 --   kli_id = :CustID and
   (ac.bal_cn1 IN (SELECT accgroup
                           FROM sbcm_acc_zone_info
                          WHERE zoneid = (SELECT g.zoneid
                                             FROM pr_acc_zones g
                                            WHERE g.name = 'emlak'))

         )
and close_dat is null
ORDER BY kli_id,accno

datasets.name: ReportDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT rownum sira, a.id, a.filialid, a.regionid, a.villageid, a.name, a.value,a.satishdeyeri,
       a.generalarea, a.livingarea, a.buildingsoilarea, a.soilarea,
       a.aktnum, a.aktdate, a.constructdate, a.usepersonname,a.aktnum||'-'||a.aktdate as sss,
       a.buycontractdate, a.endcontactdate,  a.description,
       a.contractnum, a.bdate, a.prop_count, a.accno, a.clientaccid,
       a.branchid, a.tipid, a.type#, a.previousname,f.name as f_name,p.maindebt,p.intdebt,
    cu.name as cus_name, (select acc_no from account where id=clientaccid) claccno, (select acc_no from account where id=RESERVEACCID) ehaccno,
    PG_PROPERTIES.get_sell_name(a.id) as sell_name,p.CREDITREST,
(select percent||' %'|| description  as d from reserve_types where id=a.reserveid) ehserece,
  (a.value- PG_PROPERTIES.get_sell_value(a.id) ) as qaliq , vl.name rayon, p.maindebt*rs.percent/100 eh
 FROM properties a ,filial f,properties_take p,reserve_types rs,
 cm_active_credits cr,
 /*cm_usergroups u,*/customers cu,
 agro_region vl
where  
a.branchid=f.id(+) and rs.id(+)=a.reserveid and
p.prop_id(+)=a.id and
cr.numberofcredit(+)=p.numberofcredit and
/*u.id=cr.usrgroup and*/
cu.id(+)=cr.boorowerid and a.REGIONID=vl.id(+) 










order by  a.branchid
